summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: track() gets a show_speed option (default True) passed to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gets a show_speed constructor option (default False), a class-level render_speed classmethod using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render branch for unknown totals; Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables and types task_total as Optional[float]. Added a CHANGELOG line, removed the two ValueError assertions in tests/test_progress.py, and added test_task_progress_column_speed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run per instructions; the changes were verified by reading only. No commits were made.
